Name: Mr. Qi Portrait and Sprite Mod for Friendable Mr. Qi (cardodecomer style)
Author: FroggyLittleBeasty
Description:
[center]Ever taken a look at cardodecomer's beautiful (now previous) Mr. Qi sprite and go, 'yeah, I wanna date that'?
Well now's your chance, with AngelOfStars's Friendable (and romanceable) Mr. Qi mod! 

I am not by any means a modder. I just wanted to date Gojo Mr. Qi, so if there are issues with adding the portraits and sprites, leave a comment and hope and pray someone who knows more responds. Also, if you know how to fix any issues you run into, please comment how you did for me and others and I'll attempt to fix them!

[b]Friendable Mr. Qi [/b]by AngelOfStars
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31511]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31511
[/url]﻿
[b]cardo-de-comer's portraits [/b]by cardodecomer
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15580?tab=description]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15580?tab=description

[color=#ffffff][b]Mod kindly built [/b]by Abagaianye[/color]
[/url][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye﻿]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye﻿

[/url][b]TO﻿ INSTALL- Simply unzip the folder from you downloads and into your mods folder!
[/b]﻿﻿[b]!!DISCLAIMER!!
[/b]I cannot stress enough, the first two portraits were made by cardodecomer. They were kind enough to give me permission to use their art to make this. Go follow them on [url=https://www.tumblr.com/cardo-de-comer]tumblr[/url]﻿! The rest [i]were [/i]made by me, but I do not want to at all claim ownership of this style or credit for this design. All sprites, however, were made by me.

Flower dance portrait is different, but his sprite is the same, same as the winter outfit.

[b]Hopefully to do soon:[/b]
[s]1. Make this an actual working mod instead of whatever it is now
[/s]Thank you Abagaianye for making it into a working mod!
2. Make separate winter, married, and flower dance sprites + portraits
3. Make Ms. Qi in the same style[/center]
